description: This file provides helper functions and enums for UI automator testing, specifically to check if a UI element has a certain number of children based on specified conditions.

classes.name: UiObject2Condition
classes.description: A condition class used to evaluate properties of UiObject2 elements, particularly whether they satisfy certain child count criteria.

methods.name: untilHasChildren
methods.description: Returns a condition that checks if a UiObject2 element has a number of children satisfying the specified operation and count.
